tasks.subject: Task 1: tarball detection helpers
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A pure module `lib/tarballs.ts` exports `isTarballRepo`, `isTarballTarget`, and `tarballRepoOrder`, with a `.test-d.ts` pinning their signatures.

**Files:**
- Create: `frontend/src/lib/tarballs.ts`
- Create: `frontend/src/lib/tarballs.test-d.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `isTarballRepo` true for `ssl3`/`ssl1.1`/`ssl3.5`, false for `RockyLinux_9`/`ubi9`
- [ ] `isTarballTarget` requires the project to end `:tarballs` AND an ssl repo
- [ ] `tarballRepoOrder` sorts `ssl1.1` < `ssl3` < `ssl3.5`
- [ ] `npm run build` exits 0

**Verify:** `cd frontend && npm run build` → exit 0

**Steps:** Per plan Task 1 (full code in the plan): create `tarballs.ts` (`isTarballRepo` = `/^ssl/i`, `isTarballTarget` = endsWith `:tarballs` && isTarballRepo, `tarballRepoOrder` = numeric localeCompare); create `tarballs.test-d.ts` pinning the three signatures; build. Commit `git commit -s -m "feat(artifacts): tarball detection helpers"` (never Co-Authored-By).

tasks.subject: Task 2: derive tarballs in useArtifacts
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `useArtifacts` exports a `Tarball` interface and a `tarballs` computed that fans tarball packages out per ssl repo (one card per (package, ssl-repo)), returned alongside `packageRows`/`containerImages`.

**Files:**
- Modify: `frontend/src/composables/useArtifacts.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Exported `Tarball` interface `{ id, project, name, version, repo, arches, rollupState, published, builtAt }`
- [ ] `tarballs` filters projects ending `:tarballs` at the matching version, emits one Tarball per distinct ssl-repo target (via `isTarballTarget`); `arches` distinct; `builtAt` = latest target `started_at`; `published` = any such target published
- [ ] RockyLinux targets inside a `:tarballs` package yield no tarball
- [ ] `useArtifacts` returns `tarballs`
- [ ] `npm run build` exits 0

**Verify:** `cd frontend && npm run build` → exit 0

**Steps:** Per plan Task 2 (full code in the plan): import `isTarballTarget`; add `Tarball` interface after `ContainerImage`; add `tarballs` computed (filter endsWith `:tarballs` + matchesProject, flatMap over ssl-repo targets, per-repo arches/builtAt/published); return `{ packageRows, containerImages, tarballs }`; build. Commit `git commit -s -m "feat(artifacts): derive tarballs per ssl repo in useArtifacts"` (never Co-Authored-By).

tasks.subject: Task 3: TarballsSubTab card component
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A `TarballsSubTab.vue` renders tarballs grouped by ssl repo, each card showing a "Tarball · <repo>" label, name, version, arch chips, build-state badge, and built time; with a `.props.test-d.ts`.

**Files:**
- Create: `frontend/src/components/TarballsSubTab.vue`
- Create: `frontend/src/components/TarballsSubTab.props.test-d.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Props `tarballs: Tarball[]`, `loading?: boolean` (no copy affordance)
- [ ] Grouped by `repo`, sorted `ssl1.1`→`ssl3`→`ssl3.5` via `tarballRepoOrder`; header shows repo + "N tarball(s)"
- [ ] Card shows tarball icon, "Tarball" pill + repo code, name, version (omitted when empty), arch chips, rebuild badge, built time (omitted when empty)
- [ ] No REGISTRY/TAGS/DOCKER PULL/SECURITY sections
- [ ] Empty state "No tarballs for this version."
- [ ] `npm run build` exits 0

**Verify:** `cd frontend && npm run build` → exit 0

**Steps:** Per plan Task 3 (full component code in the plan): clone ContainersSubTab structure, group by repo sorted via tarballRepoOrder, drop registry/tags/pull/cve, add ARTIFACT (Tarball pill+repo)/VERSION/ARCHITECTURES/BUILT sections, scoped styles for spinner/section-label/status-badge; create props.test-d.ts; build. Commit `git commit -s -m "feat(artifacts): TarballsSubTab card component"` (never Co-Authored-By).

tasks.subject: Task 5: Tarballs sub-tab plumbing + panel wiring
tasks.description:

**Acceptance Criteria:**

tasks.subject: Task 6: release tarball artifacts (backend)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The Releases artifacts endpoint returns a `tarballs` array built from ssl-repo binaries under `…:releases:<version>:tarballs` subprojects, covered by a Go table test.

**Files:**
- Modify: `backend/internal/api/release_artifacts.go`
- Modify: `backend/internal/api/release_artifacts_test.go`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `ReleaseTarballArtifact {Project, Name, Version, Repo, Arch, BuiltAt}` added; `ReleaseArtifactsResponse` gains `Tarballs []ReleaseTarballArtifact` (`json:"tarballs"`)
- [ ] `buildReleaseArtifacts` searches `project+":tarballs"` subprojects, lists binaries, populates `Tarballs` via `buildReleaseTarballArtifacts`

- [ ] `go test ./internal/api/ -run ReleaseTarball -count=1` passes; `go build ./...` OK

**Verify:** `cd backend && go test ./internal/api/ -run ReleaseTarball -count=1 -v && go build ./...` → PASS, build OK
